verdict.rationale: Expensify's Integration Server API issues static partner credentials (partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret) and supports OAuth2 tokens, so scripts and server-side jobs can drive it without the UI. The pack shows no CLI, headless runner, or CI-specific guidance, and does not document which operations the API covers, so headless/CI use is only implied through raw API calls. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless mode, CI/automation documentation or examples, documented API operation coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
